title: [Nov 16 - Dec 16] AI Game Jam: $100K in Cash Prizes (sponsored by ElevenLabs, fal.ai and Meshy)
author: yerbamate2020
selftext:
Hey there - long time lurker on this sub! Me and a few other friends (fellow victims of AI game creation addiction) are putting together a big virtual game jam starting Nov 18th running through Dec 18th. There's $100k in cash prizes across various genres/tracks BUT the most important thing is just bringing together people who have a lot of fun building games.

Some helpful info:

\- You can use whatever tools you typically use to build and any major game engine that exports to the web.  
\- We have some cool judges involved like Ryan Hoover (the creator of Product Hunt), Thomas Ricouard (OpenAI/Codex guy who posts a ton about AI game dev) and a bunch of game devs/creators from X/Twitter such as @ \_chuckyc, @ chongdashu, @ TheCodeTherapy, @ 0xGuavaGuy, @ MeticulAi and more.  
\- Meshy, fal, and Elevenlabs are kind enough to be sponsoring the event and giving out free starter credits to the extent you want them (not required). They are also giving out lots of credits to dedicated track-winners for "Best use of \[their tool\]" - separate from the cash prize pool  
\- 18+, individuals only (no teams), can leverage already-created assets but all games must be started and finished during the game jam period  
\- Since I know people likely want to know, exact prize pool is as follows:  
*(i) Best Game Overall: $50,000 prize pool: 1st place receives $25,000, 2nd place $17,500, and 3rd place $7,500. All games are automatically considered, regardless of genre.*

*(i) Top 3 in Each Genre: $50,000 total prize pool: Each of the 10 genres awards*   
*5,000(2,500 for 1st, $1,500 for 2nd, $1,000 for 3rd). Genres include Shooter & Survival, Action & Adventure, RPG, Platformer, Strategy, Simulation & Management, Racing & Sports, Fighting, Puzzle & Casual, and Party, Social & Sandbox.*  
  
*\*Prizes displayed are gross amounts. Payouts are net of any tax we are required by law to withhold.*

  
Anyways… if you have any time between November 18th and December 18th and want to vibe out with us, we’d love to have you. If you want to get notified when it launches (and about the rules), you can toss your email into [opengame.io](http://opengame.io), which is the site we're building to host this.

  
Happy to answer any questions in the thread!

comments.author: Abnegatethehate
comments.body: Can it be a game that’s already in development? Or does it have to be from scratch?

replies.author: yerbamate2020
replies.body: Game must be started and finished during the game jam, to ensure fairness for all participants and to compare apples to apples!

replies.author: mmnyeahnosorry
replies.body: Would starting a new build the day it starts and importing all those assets from a previous build disqualify you?

replies.author: yerbamate2020
replies.body: Assets (like sfx, 3d models, textures) can be brought from asset packs/other games -> but the core game must be started and finished within the period!

Like many hackathons - it will be based on a trust system & community policing; when picking winners we will also do a reverse search of their game code on the web!

For the credits from ElevenLabs/fal/Meshy - yes, there will be free participant credits specifically for the game jam, and then the track-prize winners will get even more credits from each provider that they can use for whatever
